一句话作用: Local hybrid search for markdown notes and docs. Use when searching notes, finding related content, or retrieving documents from indexed collections.
关键输入: - Bun = 1.0.0 - macOS: brew install sqlite (SQLite extensions) - Ensure PATH includes: $HOME/.bun/bin Install Bun (macOS): brew install oven-sh/bun/bun
关键输出: 过程辅助，无固定交付物
解决具体问题: 当需要- "search my notes / docs / knowledge base" - "find related notes" - "retrieve a markdown document from my collection" - "search local markdown files"时，用它完成对应判断、生成或操作流程。
